final: SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(CAST(r.round AS FLOAT)) AS circuit_avg_round, AVG(CAST(r.round AS FLOAT)) - (SELECT AVG(CAST(r2.round AS FLOAT)) FROM races r2 JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId WHERE c2.country = c.country) AS diff_from_baseline FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country ORDER BY diff_from_baseline IS NULL, diff_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
